sourceFlow.description: Existing main factory new i.pn resolves through exports.pn to mB; registry/getConnection lookup supplies the client parameter to mge.runPrediction -> fge. No observed running instance is asserted.
ensureReady -> startAppServerProcess -> connectAndWaitForOpen; the initializer sends CL(options, trace), whose request uses module SL=__codex_initialize__ and method initialize.
Before initialization, nL(e), exact response ID __codex_initialize__ and pending resolveInitialize select the branch. A truthy e.error rejects; otherwise t=e.result and o.sn(t.userAgent) is read.

Module-level const o require -> application-network-startup exports.sn getter -> top-level D -> T.exec(input)?.groups?.version ?? null. It parses the slash-form userAgent string, not serverInfo.version or package metadata.

For a remote host, a non-null unsupported parsed version selects rejectInitialize. Otherwise initializedCodexHome/platformFamily/platformOs are assigned, initializedAppServerVersion=r is assigned, then resolveInitialize() is called.

mB.appServerVersion returns initializedAppServerVersion. For the statically linked candidate client, fge passes e.appServerVersion into main r.Ti(version, experimentalPredictionForkMode). Prior complete gate I rejects null/invalid semantic versions, normally compares against alpha.20, and retains the explicit alpha.17.2 exception and 0.0.0 sentinel branch.

completeInitialization and sendInitializationSnapshot use getInitializationMessage -> LL. The codex-app-server-initialized object carries appServerVersion and installedCodexVersion as separate fields. Actual delivery/order/value remain unknown.

connectAndWaitForOpen separately awaits options.transport.getInstalledCodexVersion() into installedCodexVersion; publishRestartAvailableErrorMessage can update that separate installed value. Neither named assignment writes initializedAppServerVersion.

initializedAppServerVersion is declared null and clearInitializedHost resets it to null. Named reset calls appear in connectAndWaitForOpen, stopProcess and handleTransportClosed in this complete class; computed/external mutation remains unknown.

staticFailureCases.input: Matching initialize response with a truthy error field
staticFailureCases.deduction: Reject branch selected; userAgent parser and version assignment are not reached.

staticFailureCases.input: Matching response result exists but userAgent is missing, null or an ordinary nonmatching string
staticFailureCases.deduction: No explicit typeof guard exists in this member or D. Ordinary RegExp.exec string coercion gives no slash/version match in these stated cases, so D returns null. The remote unsupported guard requires r!=null; this branch can assign null and resolve initialization. Later prediction I rejects null.

staticFailureCases.input: Non-string userAgent outside the saved schema contract
staticFailureCases.deduction: No local string-type validation is present; outcome depends on built-in string coercion and input value. Custom object/symbol or accessor failures are not modeled; cannot claim universal null or graceful rejection.

staticFailureCases.input: Matching response with result missing/null; nL requires an id plus a result or error property. If result is absent, an error property must exist and be non-truthy to reach this read branch.
staticFailureCases.deduction: Under those exact response-shape/error conditions, t.userAgent access has no local optional guard or try/catch here and can throw before assignment. A message with neither result nor error is not selected by nL; a truthy error instead selects rejection. Handling in upstream incoming-line/transport machinery is not traced by this result.

staticFailureCases.input: userAgent contains slash followed by a non-whitespace token that is not a valid semantic version
staticFailureCases.deduction: D performs token extraction only. Semantic-version validation belongs to prior gate I; prediction gate returns false for invalid version. Remote compatibility comparison has a separate implementation and is not a promise of graceful malformed-response handling.

staticFailureCases.input: No matching initialize ID/pending resolver or message arrives after initialized=true
staticFailureCases.deduction: The named initialize assignment branch is not selected. No actual notification ordering or connection-generation event sequence is observed.
